title: CRISPR screens in 3D tumourspheres identified miR-4787-3p as a transcriptional start site miRNA essential for breast tumour-initiating cell growth
model: MCF-7 and HCC1395 breast cancer cells, GeCKO v2 genome-wide knockout library (genes and miRNAs), 2D culture vs 3D tumourspheres
contrast: MCF-7 3D tumourspheres vs 2D culture, 3-4 weeks (1 vs 1 library); HCC1395 not reported (bottlenecked)
paper_method: MAGeCK-MLE (3D-2D beta difference; FDR < 0.05 in 3D vs T0 and |3D-2D beta| > 0.4)
paper_calls: MCF-7: 235 protein-coding genes depleted and 17 enriched (plus miRNAs); HCC1395: 320 depleted and 24 enriched; no FDR on the 3D-2D difference itself
barcs_calls: MCF-7: 14 genes at FDR 0.10 (6 against the control null), most driven by single jackpot guides; HCC1395 not reported (libraries bottlenecked from T0)
verdict: With one library per arm, BARCS finds no support for the paper's named hits: miR-4787 and its targets ARHGAP17, FOXO3 and PDCD4 sit far from significance in both cell lines. BARCS's own few MCF-7 calls are mostly single jackpot guides from clonal tumourspheres.
